use_case: Customer chatbot on the website and by text: answers repair questions, gives ticket status, books appointments, and gives price ranges from the price list
vendor_or_model: Chatbot vendor (generative language model with retrieval over the company's FAQ and price list; status lookups through the connector function)
data_categories: Customer questions; first name, ticket number, and status; anything customers type (sample found passcodes and card numbers)
consequential_decision_category: None (customer service); escalates if it ever makes refund, warranty, or credit decisions
human_in_the_loop: Staff take over on request, for complaints, and for any price outside the price list; chatbot cannot change tickets or approve anything
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) and 45(n) (claims, disclosure, data use); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) and (6) (chat data; vendor as third-party agent); PCI DSS v4.0.1 SAQ P2PE eligibility (card numbers typed into chat)
status: In production since 2026-03; approved with conditions

use_case: AI-assisted diagnostics: analyzes device diagnostic logs and damage photos and suggests the likely fault and repair
vendor_or_model: Diagnostics vendor (machine learning model trained by the vendor on repair data)
data_categories: Device diagnostic logs (may include device name, account identifiers, and installed apps); photos of device damage
consequential_decision_category: None directly; influences what repair and price a customer is quoted
human_in_the_loop: Technician must confirm the fault before any quote; the customer approves the quote
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) (the '99% accurate' claim) and 45(n) (unneeded repairs); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) and (6)
status: Pilot at the Depot and Store A since 2026-06; approved with conditions

use_case: General-purpose generative AI used by staff for emails, social posts, and repair write-ups
data_categories: Risk of customer data, device photos, or passcodes being pasted
risk_tier: Low (High if customer data is entered)
status: Prohibited for customer data (POL-05 4.9); approved business tool with data-use terms under evaluation
